subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this remain distinct reasoning-stream plus chat.history recovery work, and what Telegram contract should apply when a preview or final send is stuck in send_attempt_started without a reconciler?
rationale: Source evidence shows a real no-replay safety guard, but the maintainer tradeoff is whether Telegram should add reconciliation, a bounded fallback, a diagnostic-only recovery, or fold this into the broader guarded-lane work.

options.title: Track Distinct Recovery Work
options.body: Keep this issue open for Telegram /reasoning stream live proof, unknown-send recovery design, and a separate chat.history backpressure check.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning/history details as symptoms and track the delivery recovery behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and its candidate PR.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and open or select a narrower Control UI/Gateway history-pressure item after proof.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Recovery Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for Telegram /reasoning stream live proof, unknown-send recovery design, and a separate chat.history backpressure check.

likelyOwner.reason: The unknown-send replay safety decision is closest to recent outbound recovery work on already-sent reply replay.
